# Refer Labs

> Refer Labs is an Australian comparison and research platform. Consumers use it to choose between health services, software and tools through independent, disclosed comparisons; businesses partner with it for featured placement, referral programs and growth services. Rankings are never sold. Some pages contain disclosed affiliate links.

## Category hubs
- [Weight Loss in Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/weight-loss): The flagship hub. Compare medical telehealth, lifestyle programs and the GP pathway, with 11 supporting guides.
- [For Business](https://referlabs.com.au/for-business): Featured partnerships, growth services, and the Referral Growth Blueprint product.

## Key facts
- Entity: Refer Labs (Australian growth and distribution engine; independent comparison publisher)
- Primary market: Australia (en-AU); also serves US and UK
- Contact: jarred@referlabs.com.au
- Flagship product: Referral Growth Blueprint — 250+ vetted affiliate/referral programs, personalised strategy brief, SEO page concepts, distribution playbooks. $799 AUD, delivered within 48 hours.
- Disclosure: Some comparison and review pages contain affiliate referral links. Refer Labs may earn a commission at no extra cost to the reader. Editorial assessments are independent.

## Comparison guides (independent, not pay-to-rank)
- [Best Weight Loss Telehealth Australia 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/best-weight-loss-telehealth-australia): Moshy vs Juniper vs Better Being — GLP-1 access, eligibility process, pricing, and community verdict.
- [Best Hair Loss Treatment Australia 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/best-hair-loss-treatment-australia): Mosh vs Dense Hair Experts vs telehealth — finasteride and minoxidil access, clinical vs topical, pricing.
- [Best Peptide Supplier 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/best-peptide-supplier): Apollo Peptide Sciences vs Ascension Peptides vs BioPeptiTech — purity standards, catalogue, discount codes. Research use only.
- [Best Website Builder 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/best-website-builder): Carrd vs Durable AI vs Butternut AI vs Swipe Pages — free plans, AI generation, pricing.
- [Best Newsletter Platform 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/best-newsletter-platform): beehiiv vs Substack vs ConvertKit — free plans, monetisation, growth tools.
- [Australia Health & Performance Comparison Platform](https://referlabs.com.au/comparison-website): Curated comparisons across ED, weight loss, hair loss, testosterone, and supplements.
- [All Guides & Comparisons](https://referlabs.com.au/guides): Full index of comparison guides and brand reviews.

## Health & telehealth (Australia)
- [Moshy Weight Loss — Review, Cost & Eligibility](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy): Australian men's weight-management telehealth. GLP-1/semaglutide eligibility, cost, Moshy vs Juniper, reviews. GLP-1 medications are prescription-only and subject to individual clinical assessment.
- [Moshy Review](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-review): Independent walk-through of how the Moshy service runs in practice, from application to subscription.
- [Moshy Eligibility Check Explained](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-eligibility): What the online quiz asks, what happens after submitting, and why some applications are declined.
- [Moshy Alternatives](https://referlabs.com.au/moshy-alternatives): The realistic alternatives in Australia: a GP, Juniper for women, Better Being for lifestyle-first.
- [Weight Loss Telehealth for Men in Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/weight-loss-telehealth-men-australia): How men's services work and the checklist before signing up with any provider.
- [Online Weight Loss Programs Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/online-weight-loss-programs-australia): Medical telehealth vs lifestyle programs vs self-serve apps, untangled.
- [Men's Health Telehealth Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/mens-health-telehealth-australia): How online men's clinics work, with Moshy (weight) and Mosh (hair) as the main doors.
- [Mosh Hair Loss — Review, Cost & Treatments](https://referlabs.com.au/moshhair): Australian men's hair-loss telehealth. Finasteride and minoxidil access, cost/pricing, Mosh vs Dense, reviews. Prescription treatments subject to clinical assessment.
- [Dense Hair Experts — Review & Offer](https://referlabs.com.au/dense): Australian topical hair-density products (non-prescription).

## Website builders & tools
- [Carrd — Free Website Builder Review](https://referlabs.com.au/carrd): Free plan forever, Pro from $9/year. Best for one-page sites, portfolios, link-in-bio.
- [Durable AI — AI Website Builder Review](https://referlabs.com.au/durableai): Generate a business website in ~30 seconds; includes CRM and invoicing.
- [Butternut AI — AI Website Generator Review](https://referlabs.com.au/butternut): Full website from a prompt in ~20 seconds.
- [Swipe Pages — Landing Page Builder Review](https://referlabs.com.au/swipepages): AMP landing pages with sub-1s load; 14-day free trial.
